items.title: Christopher "Happy" Goldston Interview, 1962-04-11
items.q: I played with John. I played with John McCollum.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm . drums when you were playing if you made a mistake? You know I think Octave told me the trumpet player sometimes would kind of straighten him out when he was young.
Yeah, they did. They could kind of straighten him by seeing other drummers play. I played with John. I played with John McCollum.
What about Clay Jones? Did you ever hear him?
